items.rationale: The selected glazing cover includes drilling needed to fit the hardware under §§1.3 and 2.7.2. Allow €20 gross for one hole; no deductible amount is stated.

items.description: Fit replacement glass into the existing frame
items.rationale: Fitting is covered glazing work under §2.7.2. Allow €45 gross for fitting one pane into the existing frame, excluding the separately billed travel.
Sections 2.7.1–2.7.2 cover the cracked cabinet pane and its made-to-measure replacement. Allow €75 gross for one pane matching the pre-loss specification under §7.1.10, without an upgrade.

items.description: Vehicle charge for the fitting visit
items.rationale: Sections 2.7.2 and 7.1.12 cover one attendance by the contractor when covered fitting is performed. Allow €25 gross for that visit, with no apportionment.
